questions.stem: Which method would be most suitable for measuring the rate of a reaction that produces hydrogen gas?

options.text: Collecting the gas in a gas syringe and recording the volume over time
Using a colorimeter to measure colour change
Measuring the pH change with a pH probe

questions.explanation: A gas syringe is ideal for measuring the rate of a reaction that produces gas. It collects the hydrogen gas and allows you to record the volume at regular intervals. It works for all gases and provides accurate, continuous measurements.
